Emma (AE): Hey team — quick heads up, GovHealth wants us to run a 2‑week POC but Legal says they need a signed NDA + an explicit pen-test signatory/letter before we can start. Also asked for SOC 2 in-scope artifact zip. POC kickoff is Tue 09:00 PT. Who can own getting the signer and artifacts together?
Jason (SE): I can stand up the POC infra. For pen-test we usually provide a one-page letter that lists allowed targets and timeframe. Do they require a named signee (CISO/Legal) or just an authorized rep?
Emma (AE): They said "named, company-authorized signatory" — their procurement flagged it for federal supplier rules. Preferably someone in Legal or Security with authority.
Maria (Security): I can draft the pen-test letter, but Legal needs to approve signature authority. Also need clarity on scope: will GovHealth want external red-team (they asked for 3rd-party scan) or just our internal vulnerability scan?
Ryan (Solutions Eng): For the POC network wise: they want private subnets and static egress IPs. That affects how we generate audit logs for SOC2 evidence. If Legal delays signer, we can still prep SOC2 artifact bundle (control narratives, AOC, SOC2 summary) and a sample pen-test template.
Olivia (Sales Ops): I have the GovHealth procurement contact info. Do we have a standard presigned SFTP or Box link for artifact upload? If not, I can provision a secure Dropbox link this afternoon.
Jason (SE): Re: pen-test scope — can we limit to the POC env only (non-prod) and exclude third-party integrations? That reduces timeline. Also need to confirm whether they require a red-team report or just a signed letter confirming we permit them to run tests.
Maria (Security): Prefer: scope = POC infra only, IPs listed explicitly, no social‑engineering, scheduled window. I'll attach a draft letter below. Please review and flag any legal language needs.
Maria (Security): ```Pen‑Test Authorization Letter (draft):
Company: Redwood Inference
POC: GovHealth (staging)
Scope: IPs: 10.11.12.0/24 (POC hosts), endpoints: inference-api.internal.redwood, admin UI (staging).
Excluded: production systems, external partner endpoints, employee social engineering.
Dates: 2026-04-07 to 2026-04-10 (window)
Signer: <Authorized Signatory> (to be filled by Legal)
Note: Tests must comply with our acceptable-use rules and be coordinated with Redwood on timing.
```
Emma (AE): Thanks Maria. LegalBot, can you confirm who is authorized to sign on behalf of Redwood for this type of letter?
LegalBot: Emma, standard playbook: CISO or Head of Legal may sign. For federal customers we recommend Head of Legal + countersign from Security for technical accuracy. Provide the final draft and I'll queue it for review.
Olivia (Sales Ops): I created a secure folder: https://box.com/s/redwood-govhealth-poc (placeholder link). Uploaded checklist: SOC2_summary.pdf, SOC2_AOC_placeholder.pdf, control_map.xlsx. I can add the draft pen-test letter when Maria finalizes.
Ryan (Solutions Eng): FYI — static egress + VPC peering options may have a modest fee for reserved NAT. If GovHealth insists on single IP egress for allowlisting, we should surface potential pricing impact to procurement.
Emma (AE): Good call. Olivia / Jason — can you estimate any pricing delta for reserved egress IP and isolated staging for 2 weeks? I want that in the SOW.
Jason (SE): Quick estimate: reserved egress / isolated slice for 2 weeks ~= $1.2k — includes reserved NAT + small GPU reservation. I'll send a line-item.
Olivia (Sales Ops): Noted. I'll include it in the quote and mark it as "security configuration fee (one-time)".
Maria (Security): One more ask from GovHealth: they want proof of completed external pentest at the org level within the last 12 months. We can provide a redacted executive summary (no vuln details) and the pentest attestation letter.
Emma (AE): Do we have a redacted summary ready?
Maria (Security): Yes — I can redact and upload the exec summary and the attestation by EOD. I'll add notes about scope and remediation status.
LegalBot: Uploads accepted. Reminder: redact all client-identifying info before sharing. Use the provided secure folder link.
Emma (AE): Timeline check — if Maria uploads artifacts today and Legal approves signer tomorrow morning, we can proceed with the POC kickoff Tue. Everyone ok with that cadence?
Ryan (Solutions Eng): Sounds good. I'll prep infra config and a one‑page ops runbook for the testers so we can coordinate maintenance windows.
Jason (SE): I'll whitelist the IP range and create the staging creds. Need Olivia to confirm access window after Legal signs.
Olivia (Sales Ops): I'll coordinate procurement and send the SOW + quote once I have Jason's line-item and the signer confirmation.
Maria (Security): Uploaded: SOC2_exec_summary_redacted.pdf, pentest_attestation_redacted.pdf, draft_pen_test_letter_v1.docx (in Box).
Emma (AE): Perfect — Maria, ping LegalBot when you finish redlines. Everyone, thanks — I'll follow up with GovHealth after Legal confirms the signer. :thumbsup:
